segments.title: April
segments.text: Hello Kemps Corner! April is our birthday month. Nine years of Physique 57, and the theme is Cloud Nine: a party in four acts, eight offers, and more confetti than is strictly sensible.

segments.title: ₹60L
segments.text: So, the number. Our April target for Kemps Corner is 60 lakh rupees. That's 20 per cent up on last April. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 33 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 14.4 lakh, comebacks 7.2 lakh, and everything else 5.4 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 129 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 941 leads, 480 trials, and 129 buyers, with about 27 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.

Here's where the offers come in. Eight offers carry 45.1 lakh rupees, which is 75 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Moving In Together (The 9-Month Lease)
segments.text: First up, Moving In Together, the nine-month lease. Nine months unlimited, nine freezes, the anniversary hoodie and a numbered brass key. That's 11 buyers, for 15.9 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members ready for a long commitment and returning clients who want the best price of the year.

segments.title: The 9:09 Panic Attack
segments.text: Next, the nine-oh-nine panic attack. The limited nine-class pack. That's 20 buyers, for 2.3 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Everyone: members, pack buyers and newcomers.

segments.title: Plus One, Plus Nine
segments.text: Then, Plus One, Plus Nine. Bring a friend who joins and get nine extra days. That's 10 buyers, for 1.72 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Current members bringing a never-been friend.

segments.title: The Cloud Nine 90
segments.text: Also this month, for our heaviest users, the Cloud Nine ninety. Ninety classes, one year, about fifteen hundred rupees a class in Mumbai. That's 1 buyer, for 1.35 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Party Crasher Pass
segments.text: After that, for newcomers, the Party Crasher Pass. Three classes for nine ninety-nine, party class included, credited against a first month. That's 21 buyers, for 3.4 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Faking Your Own Death Didn’t Work
segments.text: Next, for lapsed members, Faking Your Own Death Didn't Work. They get an obituary postcard, which is also their ticket to the candle-lit Séance Class. That's 20 buyers, for 3.44 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Club Nine: The Founders’ Table
segments.text: Then, Club Nine, the Founders' Table. Nine numbered annual seats per studio, with the perks doubled: four privates, eight guest passes, priority booking all year and a numbered jacket. That's 5 buyers, for 8.78 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members on 3-Month or longer plans; annual renewers.

segments.title: Spin Class (Literally)
segments.text: And finally, for renewals, Spin Class. Literally. Renew in April and spin the Wheel of Nine. That's 45 buyers, for 8.2 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members renewing 1 Month or a 12-class pack.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Platinum Hour, the launch film, and the numbered keys go live with a public counter. Week two, anniversary week: the wheel, the plank-off, Barre-stie day and the nine-oh-nine panic attack. Week three, obituary postcards, the Séance Class, the Club Nine unveiling and nine at nine on the eighteenth. Week four, the Throwback Reunion, the Golden Glute Awards, and a midnight lock-in on the thirtieth.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's April at Kemps Corner. 60 lakh rupees, eight offers, and 129 buyers to welcome. Nine years in, and honestly? We've never looked better.
